run_dump_trace: run the dump_trace script to preprocess assembly traces into torchtext datasets for tree encoding
build_torchtext_dataset: build a torchtext Dataset from assembly source and target tree examples using Field and RawField
create_bucket_iterator: create BucketIterator splits for training and validation sets with batch size one
build_source_vocab: build the source vocabulary from training examples with a minimum frequency threshold of two
process_data_for_tree_encoder: process training and validation iterators and cache them for the tree encoder model
